notes.title: Elemental Survivors launching Early Access August 25!
notes.content:
We are so thrilled to announce that our newest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2180000/Elemental_Survivors/]Elemental Survivors[/url], will be launching in Early Access on August 25!

[i]You know what's cool? Enemy hell games. You know what else is cool? Old-school RPGs. Put them together? It's like a match made in bullet-heaven! [/i]

[b]Elemental Survivors[/b] combines the best of both, in an auto-attacking, enemy extravaganza complete with unique attacks, powerful equipment, fantastical randomly-generated lands, a train of party members ready to help you with their own attacks and upgrades, god-like summons, and constantly updating content.

Go wishlist and play the demo today! If you play the demo, you have the chance to unlock the [b]demo-exclusive character[/b] that will be available in Early Access... Gloom! He's just a gloomy lad with a big ass sword.

We hope you enjoy!

<3 <3 The Samobee Team

notes.title: New quest system! Big shoppe update!
notes.content:
Well bunny farmers, it's time for a [b]BIG UPDATE![/b]

There's a whole new [b]quest system[/b] to earn more heart coins every day so you can customize your bunny with all new [b]outfits and sparkles[/b]!

Mother Gaia needs your help with some very important tasks. Come back daily for three new tasks, each with its own reward. Tasks can range from simple harvesting and match making, chatting with your bunfolk buddies, changing your look, and, of course, blushing! The harder the task, the more heart coins you'll earn. And if you complete twelve tasks, Mother Gaia will reward you with [b]BIG MONEY![/b] <3 <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38050301/3c6b1fbd876ead33c57f57d2b96ee2bf7c238d5d.png[/img]

There are [b]sooooo[/b] many new fun ways to dress up your bunny! Summery shorts! Bathing suits! [b]Skulls, hearts, stars[/b] sparkles... even [b]dirt [/b](we won't judge)! Plus you can [b]fast travel[/b] to the shoppe directly from the quests menu so you can start spending those heart coins right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38050301/7a1a0b707f6a823839dccc46e0e776939389cad7.png[/img]

So [b]hop to it[/b], bunny farmers! And share screenshots of your favourite looks... we can't wait to see what you come up with!

And just so you know, we're always harvesting new ideas to make Princess Farmer a fun and cozy experience for everyone to enjoy. So there will be plenty of future updates to keep you [b]smashing those rocks, making those combos, and winning all your bunfolk buddies' hearts![/b]

Sincerely,
The Samobee Team <3 <3 <3

notes.title: Play Forever! The Quickplay Update is HERE!
notes.content:
Well bunny friends, it's finally HERE!

The long awaited Quickplay Update is LIVE NOW! Here are the new ways you can play:

Survive:
[list]
[*] Now you can affect how long until Grumpy Block moves up! Keep on making matches, build up your bar, and when it gets filled it slows down Grumpy Block! Things can get fast and furious with this one, so hang onto your bunny bonnets!
[*] You can see how long until Grumpy Block moves up again in a timer on the right side of the play area.
[*] Grumpy Block now starts on the last row so you can see his grumpy face right from the start.
[*] There is a bar above the board that fills as you make matches.
[*] Occasionally there will be a "veggie/rock event" (an event that has a chance of making you very rich too!).
[*] You'll be scored based on how long you survived.
[/list]

Storm:
[list]
[*] Survive ever increasing storms with this mode. The storms get faster, stick around longer, and Grumpy 
[*] Block just keeps moving up faster!
[*] Pro tip: this is a great way to get your Storms Survived achievements!
[*] You'll be scored based on how many storms you survived.
[/list]

Endless:
[list]
[*] You can just sit back, relax, play forever or for just a few minutes!
[*] Occasionally there will be a "veggie/rock event" (an event that has a chance of making you very rich too!).
[*] You'll be scored based on your score per minute.
[/list]

Timed Score:
[list]
[*] You can choose short (1 minute), medium (2 minutes), or long (5 minutes). Just a quick challenge to cheer you up and let you have a quick escape during your day!
[*] You'll be scored based on your final score.
[/list]

The other big change is that you can now see your Quickplay high score on the level select. Challenge yourself! Post screenshots of your best scores! (note that any previous Quickplay scores will not have been saved)

We hope you love and enjoy this update. Thank you to all who provided the feedback and ideas for this fun update, and to all of you for your support!

Sincerely,
Samobee Games

notes.title: New Quickplay modes are coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello bunny farmers!

We have had this update in the works since we saw you all asking for it: new quickplay modes!

Soon you'll have new modes, new scoring, new opportunities to show Grumpy Block who's boss!

In Survival mode, you will now have the power to slow down Grumpy Block by doing what you're so good at: making matches!

In Storm mode, you'll have to weather ever increasing storms... try not to get too wet! (Pro tip: this mode will help those of you struggling to get the Storm achievements.)

In Endless mode, just play forever! Really! You might even dig up buried treasure...

In Timed Score mode, you'll pick short, medium, or long. It's a nice way to spend a few minutes to brighten your day!

Thank you all for your support. We just love reading what you are enjoying about Princess Farmer. You all are seriously lovely people! <3 <3 <3

Keep on winning those hearts! <3

The Samobee Team

notes.title: Coming March 31st!
notes.content:
We are so excited to announce that Princess Farmer will be releasing on March 31st! That's next week!! That's right: you can be the magical bunny farmer you've always wanted to be NEXT WEEK!!!

If you haven't already, please wishlist so you can be notified the moment it launches so you can meet all of the adorable characters, play all of the new levels (there's 80 total at launch, with 3 playstyles and quickplay mode so that's truly over 240 levels!), explore more of Gaia's Valley, and immerse yourself in the light-hearted magical-girl story of Princess Farmer!

notes.title: It's Time to Get Hyped!
notes.content:
We hope everyone has been enjoying the demo! We just love hearing the feedback about the playstyles and the story. Did anyone catch the secret dev testing cheat that we accidentally left in there? Let us know in the comments! We might also be convinced to give hints about it to help you figure it out...

We also hope you're getting hyped for the game's release! It's getting so close and we're just putting in oodles of magical finishing touches. We're feeling pretty emotional about the journey Princess Farmer has been to make, how much we've learned, the people we've connected with, and the story of Princess Farmer herself.

This game has such an enormous part of our hearts and our stories in there as well, and we hope so much that you all can feel the love. 

Mother Gaia will ALWAYS be proud of you.

<3 The Samobee team

notes.title: First Big Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]First big update since the demo launched![/h1]
We've been working super hard on the game and can't wait to show it to you! There is still no definite date for release. But you can follow our progress on [url=https://twitter.com/SamobeeGames]Twitter @SamobeeGames[/url]. You can also come hang out with us at the [url=https://discord.gg/whitethorngames]Whitethorn Games Discord channel[/url].

[b]A big warning[/b]: your saved progress, including hare dye purchases and heart coins, is going to get wiped. There were just too many updates to fundamental things to be able to keep old saves working. It's still in very active development, after all!

[h1]Major Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [i][b]New level balancing! [/b][/i]We noticed there are generally 2 types of players: people who like to go fast and just zone out, and people who ponder each move and take their time with it. And so Soft Bunny/Tough Bunny/Diamond Bunny are now Action Bunny/Puzzle Bunny/Balanced Bunny! And all three are unlocked right from the start! Pick Action Bunny if you want breezy levels and not have to plan too much, pick Puzzle Bunny if you prefer to spend time to plan your moves to maximize whatever the level's goal is, and pick Balanced Bunny if you want a mix of both.
[*] [i][b]Goal Deets![/b][/i] (That's what my wife called them so I just stuck with it) Since we've added more complex goals and things to avoid, we also added this UI element to give you a visual reminder of what you should be focusing on. You'll find two boxes right under your Stack UI at the (usually) right side of the board. The green box means you should aim for that to maximize your reward, and the red box means that's what you want to avoid (unless it's time. You can't avoid time. Sadly.)
[*] [i][b]Return to Cottage![/b][/i] Once you've bought some cool new hare dyes from Ro's Shoppe, you can now access Return to Cottage from the pause menu (Esc on keyboard and Start on controller) so you can change into them right away! Don't worry though; once you leave the cottage you can get back to where you left off when you open up your map.
[/list]

[h1]Minor Updates/Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lots! But let us know if you come across any bugs at contact@samobee.com or on the [url=https://discord.gg/whitethorngames]Whitethorn Discord[/url].
[/list]

notes.title: Princess Farmer playthrough with BeeYoo
notes.content:
Princess Farmer is a charming visual novel meets match 3 puzzle game. In this livestream, join BeeYoo, streamer and community manager at Whitethorn Games, as she takes you through the demo for Episode 2: A Mystery in the Woods! This will be a feel-good, laid back, relaxing stream so grab some tea and your favourite fuzzy bunny slippers!

For the first time ever, you too can play the Princess Farmer demo and become the magical bunny farmer you've always wanted to be! Introduce yourself to the adorable characters and build your relationships through lighthearted dialogue. Puzzle your way through the forest to discover the Mystery!
